cases.translation: The portion of Simeon was situated in the lands of Judah.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'the portion of Simeon' uses the genitive case.
The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The inheritance extended to the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition до (up to) governs the genitive case.
The preposition к (to) with location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Земля ___ была слишком велика для них.
cases.translation: The land of Judah was too large for them.
cases.explain: The possessive construction uses the genitive case.
The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The lot came to the clans of the tribe of Naphtali.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'the clans of the tribe' uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они назвали город в честь ___, своего предка.
cases.translation: They named the city after Dan, their ancestor.
cases.explain: The preposition в честь (in honor of) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Второй жребий выпал кланом рода Симеона.
reading.question: Whose lot came out second?
reading.explain: The text states Второй жребий выпал кланом рода Симеона (The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon).

reading.ru: Их надел находился среди земель Иуды, в него входили Версавия, Илишева, Малада, Хацар-Шуал, Вала, Ецем, Елталак, Бетул, Хорма, Циклак, Бет-Марковов, Хацар-Суса, Бет-Ливаов и Шарухен.
reading.question: Where was Simeon's inheritance located?
options: On the eastern side of the Jordan
reading.explain: The text states надел находился среди земель Иуды (the inheritance was in the middle of Judah's lands).

reading.question: How many cities did Simeon receive?
reading.explain: The text clearly states Тринадцать городов с окрестными поселениями (Thirteen cities with surrounding villages).

reading.ru: Третий жеребий выпал роду Завулона по их кланам.
reading.question: Whose lot came out third?
reading.explain: The text states Третий жеребий выпал роду Завулона (The third lot came out for the tribe of Zebulun).

reading.ru: Когда донитяне потеряли свою землю, они пошли и напали на Лошем.
reading.question: What did the Danites do when they lost their land?
reading.explain: The text states они пошли и напали на Лошем (they went and attacked Leshem).

reading.ru: Таковы земли, которые священник Элиазар, Иисус, сын Навин и главы семейств из родов Израиля раздали по жребию в Шила перед Господом у входа в шатер собрания.
reading.question: Who distributed the inheritances among the Israelite tribes?
options: The priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of families by lot at Shiloh
The king of Canaan and his advisors
Only Joshua and his military leaders
reading.correct: The priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of families by lot at Shiloh
reading.explain: The text states священник Элиазар, Иисус, сын Навин и главы семейств из родов Израиля раздали по жребию (the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of families distributed by lot).
